github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework.surface:
package pangolin // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework"

Package pangolin documents the panGOlin modular application framework.

The repository is establishing its M0 engineering foundation. Runtime,
persistence and security contracts are specified in design/ and are not yet
implemented. Development tools do not constitute framework conformance.

github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/e.surface:
package bootstrap // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/examples/bookstore/bootstrap"

Package bootstrap composes the M1 API/worker executables with kernel lifecycle.

FUNCTIONS

func Run(ctx context.Context, mode string, args []string, out io.Writer, decorate func(distributed.BrokerPublisher) distributed.BrokerPublisher) error
    Run keeps secrets in environment variables; file/CLI sources cannot supply
    DSNs. An optional publisher decorator is a fault-injection seam used only by
    testkit.

github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/k.surface:
package config // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/kernel/config"

Package config defines startup configuration ports; the loader is delivered in
M1.

FUNCTIONS

func URL(schemes ...string) func(string) error
    URL validates a configured adapter URL without including credentials in
    errors.


TYPES

type Loader interface {
	Load([]Source) (Reader, error)
}
    Loader copies sources in defaults/file/environment/CLI order before sealing.

func NewLoader(rules []Rule) Loader
    NewLoader seals a copy of four named layers: defaults, file, environment,
    cli.

type Reader interface {
	Lookup(string) (string, bool)
}

type Rule struct {
	Key      string
	Required bool
	Validate func(string) error
}
    Rule validates one startup value. Errors contain the key, never the value.

func StartupRules() []Rule
    StartupRules are the mandatory kernel settings; adapters add their own
    rules.

type Source struct {
	Name   string
	Values map[string]string
}

github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/p.surface:
package uow // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/persistence/uow"

Package uow defines the frozen §5 ports. No UnitOfWorkManager implementation
exists in M0.

FUNCTIONS

func Check(ctx context.Context, write bool) error
    Check is used by resource adapters before accessing a callback's executor.

func NewManager(resource Resource, defaults DefaultOptions) (UnitOfWorkManager, error)
    NewManager implements the M1 Required transactional slice. RequiresNew
    and non-default isolation fail explicitly until the M2 options matrix is
    delivered.


TYPES

type AccessMode uint8

const (
	AccessDefault AccessMode = iota
	ReadOnly
	ReadWrite
)
type Completion struct {
	ScopeID     string
	OperationID string
	Outcome     Outcome
	Err         error
}

type DefaultOptions struct {
	DefaultTimeout      time.Duration
	CleanupTimeout      time.Duration
	HookTimeout         time.Duration
	MaxRequiresNewDepth int
}

type EffectiveOptions struct {
	Mode              AccessMode
	Transactional     bool
	Isolation         Isolation
	Deadline          time.Time
	DatabaseKey       string
	ResourceScopeKind string
	ResourceScopeID   string
}

type Error interface {
	error
	Code() string
	ScopeID() string
	OperationID() string
	Outcome() Outcome
	Unwrap() error
}
    Error is the errors.As view of a UOW failure; causes remain traversable.

type Isolation uint8

const (
	IsolationDefault Isolation = iota
	ReadCommitted
	RepeatableRead
	Serializable
)
type Options struct {
	Mode        AccessMode
	Transaction TransactionMode
	Propagation Propagation
	Isolation   Isolation
	Timeout     time.Duration
}

type Outcome uint8

const (
	NotStarted Outcome = iota
	Committed
	CompletedNonTransactional
	RolledBack
	Unknown
)
type Propagation uint8

const (
	Required Propagation = iota
	RequiresNew
)
type Resource interface {
	Begin(context.Context, EffectiveOptions) (context.Context, Transaction, error)
}
    Resource installs its private executor in the returned callback context.

type Scope interface {
	ID() string
	Options() EffectiveOptions
	SaveChanges(context.Context) error
	SetRollbackOnly(error) error
	OnCompleted(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
	OnFailed(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
	OnDisposed(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
}

type Transaction interface {
	Commit(context.Context) error
	Rollback(context.Context) error
}
    Transaction is owned exclusively by Manager, never exposed to application
    code.

type TransactionMode uint8

const (
	TransactionAuto TransactionMode = iota
	Transactional
	NonTransactional
)
type UnitOfWorkManager interface {
	Within(context.Context, Options, func(context.Context) error) error
	Current(context.Context) (Scope, bool)
}
